introduction: Oregon Kids Credit is a refundable tax credit for qualifying families with young dependent children. Use the return worksheet for the year you are filing.
description: Oregon Kids Credit is a refundable tax credit for qualifying families with young dependent children. Use the return worksheet for the year you are filing.

sections.who: The state assesses young dependent children and modified income. The worksheet includes adjustments that can differ from federal adjusted gross income.
sections.get: The refundable credit can benefit a qualifying filer even without tax owed. Income and eligible children determine the award.
sections.docs:
• Dependent ages and identification.
  • Income and federal return records.
  • Any income adjustments required by the Oregon worksheet.
sections.apply:
1. Use the correct tax year

    Start with the state credit guidance.

  2. Complete the worksheet

    Check child eligibility and modified income using the return instructions.

  3. File to claim

    Use the state return and keep supporting calculations.
sections.after: Keep a copy and use Revenue’s free-tax-help resources if you need assistance.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Kids Credit refundability and calculation guidance, 2025 detailed tax guidance. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can someone with no tax owed claim it?
The state says eligible people may receive refundable credits even without taxable income or tax owed.
Does federal AGI alone settle eligibility?
No. Oregon’s worksheet includes required income adjustments.
Is this SNAP or monthly cash assistance?
It is claimed through the income-tax return.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
